cells.note: Wallet policy, issuance and transfer-control tooling · Technology layer
cells.detail: Fireblocks key and policy tooling plus Tokeny's ERC-3643 contracts can combine secure signing, mint/burn functions, identity checks, transfer restrictions, freeze, pause and recovery controls.

sources.label: Fireblocks supports Citadel Securities in DTC tokenization event

cells.text: Permissioned token controls on public chains
cells.note: Role in the SEC order: supporting layer

cells.text: Fireblocks reported that its wallet infrastructure supported Citadel Securities in DTCC's July limited-production tokenization event and current Canton connectivity.
cells.detail: Where the proof stops: A participant's limited-production wallet use does not prove general DTCC service launch, Tokeny use, authoritative title or scaled volume.

cells.text: Access + identity (capability); Stock + rights record (support); Interoperability + services (capability)
items: Access + identity · Wallet + key control, Transfer restrictions: The combined stack directly addresses signing policy and token-level transfer eligibility.
Stock + rights record · Mint / burn authority, Title / entitlement record: It can execute issuance and recovery instructions but does not determine which external register legally controls.
Interoperability + services · API / integration, Failure authority: Lifecycle APIs connect issuer, wallet and distribution systems while exact failure authority must be disclosed.

cells.text: Technical control does not itself supply broker-dealer, transfer-agent, venue, custodian or title authority, and ERC-3643 documentation's ownership language remains product- and law-dependent.
cells.note: Watch: Exact contract deployment, authorized claim issuers, compliance modules, key holders, upgrade and recovery powers, regulated agents and register reconciliation.
